zh.title: 加拿大航空休閒品牌將為波音737 MAX 8增添螢幕等客艙配備
zh.summary: 加拿大航空休閒品牌的737 MAX 8將配備座椅螢幕、可後躺座椅與免費Wi-Fi
body: Simple Flying報導，加拿大航空的休閒航空品牌將在波音737 MAX 8客機上提供座椅背螢幕、可後躺座椅與免費Wi-Fi。報導標題列出這些客艙配備，並將其與該休閒航空品牌的737 MAX 8相連。
報導摘要另稱，加拿大航空正進行大型機隊調整，並將更新後的737 MAX飛機納入Air Canada Rouge。報導提到的內容包括休閒航空品牌客機的客艙配備，以及Air Canada Rouge接收更新後737 MAX飛機的機隊調整。

en.title: Air Canada Leisure Airline to Get Screens, Reclining Seats and Free Wi-Fi on 737 MAX 8s
en.summary: Air Canada's leisure airline is getting seatback screens, reclining seats and free Wi-Fi on its 737 MAX 8s
body: Simple Flying reports that Air Canada's leisure airline is getting seatback screens, reclining seats and free Wi-Fi on its Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft. The headline lists these cabin features for the leisure airline's MAX 8s. The report's summary also says Air Canada is undergoing a major fleet reshuffle, bringing updated 737 MAX aircraft into Air Canada Rouge.

The source describes both a cabin amenity update for the leisure airline's 737 MAX 8s and a fleet change involving updated 737 MAX aircraft entering Air Canada Rouge. These are the two developments stated in the report: the listed screens, reclining seats and Wi-Fi, and the reshuffle bringing updated aircraft into Rouge.

zh.title: Aeromexico將公佈新增墨西哥城直飛航班的美國城市
zh.summary: Aeromexico預告將公佈直飛墨西哥城的新航點，時間可能在下週
body: Aeromexico將揭示哪些美國城市會新增直飛墨西哥城的航班。這項消息涉及即將公佈的航點資訊，重點是哪些美國城市會有新的直飛服務。現有資訊沒有列出具體城市，因此不能進一步指明新航點。
報導摘要指出，相關航線可能最快下週公佈。「可能」與「最快」表示公佈時間仍未確定，不能視為已確認下週發布。這則預告指向新直飛航班的航點公佈，並未表示航班已開始營運。

en.title: Aeromexico Set to Reveal US Cities for New Mexico City Nonstop Flights
en.summary: Aeromexico may reveal US cities for new Mexico City nonstop routes as soon as next week
body: Aeromexico is set to reveal which US cities will receive new nonstop flights to Mexico City. The announcement concerns the cities that would have the new service; the available headline and summary do not identify those cities.

The report says the routes could be announced as soon as next week. “Could” and “as soon as” leave the timing uncertain and do not establish a confirmed announcement date. The information describes a forthcoming route announcement, not flights already operating.

zh.title: 無人機進入土倫禁航區 法國當局展開司法調查
zh.summary: 法國當局就無人機進入土倫軍事設施周邊禁航區展開司法調查
body: 法國當局表示，在一場於2026年10月5日至16日舉行的聯合軍事演習期間，土倫周邊軍事設施附近及上空發現未經授權的無人機。地中海海事區域司令部10月21日發布聲明稱，無人機進入了涵蓋土倫的禁航區。
當局已就此展開司法調查。地中海海事區域司令部表示，每次發現無人機時均啟動反無人機系統，並與法國內部安全部門協調。該單位稱，沒有敏感基礎設施受到威脅；無人機飛行的來源仍不明。

en.title: Drones enter Toulon no-fly zone; French authorities open investigation
en.summary: French authorities open judicial investigation after drones enter Toulon no-fly zone
body: French authorities have opened a judicial investigation after unauthorized drones were detected near and over military sites around Toulon during a joint military exercise held from October 5 to 16, 2026. The Mediterranean Maritime Prefecture said in an October 21 statement that the drones had entered the no-fly zone covering Toulon.

The prefecture said counter-drone systems were activated in response to each detection, in coordination with France’s internal security forces. It also said no sensitive infrastructure had been threatened. The origin of the flights remains unknown.

zh.title: 美國航空波音787在O’Hare（ORD）緊急降落，報導稱一人住院
zh.summary: 美國航空波音787在O’Hare緊急降落；報導稱一人住院
body: Simple Flying 的標題報導，美國航空一架波音787在 O’Hare（ORD） 緊急降落，並稱有一人住院。標題以煞車拖滯描述事件；該媒體提供的摘要則稱，機師在降落前警告可能有煞車問題，保留了問題尚屬可能性的表述。
摘要接著指出，這架787-8在跑道上停下。依摘要所述，機師的警告發生在降落前，飛機則在跑道上停下；摘要將煞車問題表述為可能情況。

en.title: American Airlines Boeing 787 Makes Emergency Landing at O’Hare (ORD); One Hospitalized
en.summary: American Airlines' Boeing 787 made an emergency landing at O’Hare; Simple Flying reports one hospitalized
body: Simple Flying’s headline reports that an American Airlines Boeing 787 made an emergency landing at O’Hare (ORD) and says one person was hospitalized. The headline describes the brakes as dragging. The outlet’s summary uses more tentative wording, saying the pilots warned of a possible brake problem before landing.

The summary also says the 787-8 came to a halt on the runway. In the sequence it describes, the pilots’ warning came before landing, and the aircraft stopped on the runway afterward. The summary characterizes the brake issue as possible.
